name: List Avatar Look ID Options
description: Retrieves a page of available avatar looks, whose `id` can be used for Avatar Look ID fields. Lists `photo_avatar` looks by default; set **Avatar Type** to `digital_twin` or `studio_avatar` for other kinds, and **Ownership** to `public` or `private` to narrow further. Pass **Fields** to keep the response small. If `has_more` is true, pass `next_token` as the Token to get the next page. Example: Limit `2` and Fields `["id", "name"]` returns `{"data": [{"id": "look_1", "name": "Office look"}, {"id": "look_2", "name": "Outdoor look"}], "has_more": true, "next_token": "abc"}`. [See the documentation](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/list-avatar-looks)
